resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English and the complete European Portuguese source, glossary, review metadata, and UI context were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation, queue validation, type checking, focused tests, production build, route checks, and link validation passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh European Portuguese critique found visible interpolation tokens, identity drift, chronology, coil-lead, e-liquid, and UI false-friend defects.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Portuguese human review was performed; corrected entries remain machine reviewed.

findings.summary: Sixteen functions could return literal lower-case placeholder tokens.
evidence: The draft replaced only upper-case tokens.
findings.resolution: Reimplemented the affected catalog and Ohm functions.

findings.summary: Protected names drifted and available by used an ambiguous preposition.
evidence: The contract protects names and the date is an upper bound.
findings.resolution: Restored names and used disponível até.

findings.summary: Coil leads and power loss were translated as anatomical legs and leg strength.
Nicotine base became database, strength became goodness, and target wording referred to shooting.
evidence: These fields define an e-liquid recipe.
findings.resolution: Used explicit formulation terminology and rewrote the warning.

findings.summary: Several controls used Brazilian or unrelated senses, including cardápio, mesa, and solteiro.
evidence: These are European Portuguese software controls.
